definition: hit rate over the last 20 graded live bets below the break-even implied by the prices taken
why: no significance test: waiting for proof while live money is at risk is how a bad month becomes a bad year
evaluates: when at least one live bet has settled
fail_closed: an empty window is not a pass: the strategy stays on paper until it has a record

definition: Holm-adjusted p >= 0.05 when the backtest is re-run on data that includes the live weeks
why: a signal that disappears once the sample grows was never a signal
fail_closed: missing or unparseable adjusted p counts as broken

definition: mean CLV over the window < 0 points
why: the market moving against you is the earliest honest warning available
evaluates: once closing snapshots exist in the store
fail_closed: cannot be evaluated yet: reported as unevaluable, and V-08 blocks promotion

definition: live units 6.0 below peak, or 3.0x the backtest's own worst drawdown, whichever is larger
why: sizes the stop to the strategy's own history instead of to a mood
fail_closed: no backtest drawdown on file falls back to the absolute limit rather than to no limit

definition: any results-feed check fails, or either hash chain does not recompute
why: a number nobody can vouch for cannot support a live bet
fail_closed: unreadable file counts as a failure

definition: 3 consecutive weeks with no captured price for a market the strategy bets
why: an ungradeable strategy cannot be promoted, demoted or audited; it goes to paper
fail_closed: a failed capture job counts as an outage week

definition: demotion applies to all strategies simultaneously if D5 fires; otherwise per strategy
why: an integrity problem is not a property of one strategy
